_comment: Copy to ~/.terminal-talk/config.json and edit. All fields optional; defaults apply. The $schema reference above gives VS Code + any editor that honours json.schemas autocomplete + validation on save.

voices._comment: edge_* are free neural voices from Microsoft Edge. openai_* are premium/fallback voices used only when an OpenAI key is configured. Full Edge voice list: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/speech-service/language-support?tabs=tts

playback._comment: speed 0.5-2.5x. master_volume is 0.0-1.0. auto_prune toggles whether played clips disappear after N seconds (3-600). Toggle off if you want clips to stack up for review. tts_provider is edge or openai.

speech_includes._comment: Global defaults for what gets spoken from assistant responses. tool_calls is Claude Code-only. Per-session overrides live in session-colours.json and win over these.

panels._comment: Toolbar panel state; managed by the app.

window._comment: Populated automatically — last-saved position + dock orientation. Delete these keys to reset to centred-top on next launch.
